forest-stay-v1.title: Forest Stay — Cabin Booking Demo
forest-stay-v1.description: A fictional portfolio demo, not a real accommodation service. Discover cabins, filter by guest capacity, view dynamic details, and submit reservation requests. Server-side validation and price calculation, Supabase persistence, and a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint prevent overlapping active bookings.

caseStudy.problem: A cabin-booking demo needs to make cabin options and reservation availability clear while handling invalid requests and date conflicts reliably.
caseStudy.solution: Built a fictional cabin-booking demo with server-validated reservation requests and database-enforced protection against overlapping active bookings. Requests are stored as pending demo data; this is not a real accommodation service or a booking-confirmation system.
features: Discover cabins, filter by guest capacity, and view dynamic details, amenities, and nightly prices.
Submit reservation requests with server-side validation and server-calculated nights and total price.
Persist cabin and reservation data in Supabase.
Use a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint to prevent overlapping pending or confirmed reservations for the same cabin; cancelled reservations do not block dates.
